The '''Quest Guide''' is the fourth [[non-player character]] whom players meet in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. He gives players information about [[quests]] and the [[Quest list|quest journal]]. He also explains the differences between [[free]] quests and [[members]] quests. He is only found on [[Tutorial Island]], and can never be encountered again. During his lecture, he makes references to the quests [[Imp Catcher]] and [[Dragon Slayer I]].
